**Verdict: needs rework - two items, then this is ready.**

Built or not built: read-only review. The author is not a collaborator, so
the self-hosted test runner refuses this code by rule, and no local build
was authorized. The change is small and the test list is credible.

What is good:
- Plain-English labels, one per control; state words ("on", "off") in the
  tooltips. The tooltip suppression during a drag is right.
- The AccessKit registration (`widget_info`) gives a screen reader the
  name. The `Hash` derive for the per-button id is the correct way.
- The two new tests pin every label, the toggle words and the hover
  behaviour. The provenance line is correct.

Items to fix:
1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/viewport_bar.rs` is now 404 lines. The project
   keeps source files at about 400 lines and splits along the domain seam,
   and this file already uses that pattern (`viewport_bar_glyphs.rs`,
   `viewport_bar_controls.rs` are attached with `#[path]`). Please move
   `label()` and `tooltip()` to a sibling file the same way, for example
   `viewport_bar_text.rs`.
2. A UI change needs before and after screenshots in the PR body (project
   rule for UI PRs). Please add one picture per state with a tooltip
   showing, and the toggle states it names.

Notes:
- The head is a refresh merge of `main`; the code half is what was read.
- Issue #2914 will be moved to `in-review` - only collaborators can set
  labels, this is noted for the maintainer.

Thank you for this PR, `JSwetz`. PR #2783 adds the same hover help and is ready first, so the maintainer decided this order: PR #2783 merges, and this PR becomes a follow-up on top of it. The follow-up keeps what PR #2783 does not have: the accessible button names (`label()`) and the texts that depend on the state. The coordinator session of NeoTech makes that change on this branch (a merge of `main`, no force-push) after PR #2783 is on `main`. Issue #2914 is closed as a duplicate of #2776; this PR stays open.

Review at head fe605f8ec. Read, not built: the PR is from a fork, and the run runner takes no fork code, and no local build slot was free.

The change since 7fc28eb9a:
- `bf87523ad` splits the tooltip tests to the new `viewport_bar_tooltip_tests.rs` (321 lines) with a `#[path]` sibling mod. `viewport_bar_tests.rs` is back to 285 lines and `viewport_bar.rs` is 276. All files obey the 400-line rule. The earlier finding is met.
- `fe605f8ec` merges main, and main now carries the merged PR #2783 - the same hover-help feature, in a static form. The hand resolution fuses the two: main's draw-list and hover-suppression code stands, and the PR's richer `tooltip(kind, state)` supplies the text (shortcut keys, the state-aware Display menu entries). `hover_text` and the drag/outside assertions from #2783's tests stand beside the PR's own paint tests. I read the remerge-diff: no side's lines were dropped. The screenshot generator's opt-in change survived.

Why the yellow label: the merge joined two live implementations of one feature by hand and no bot built the result. The read says it is right; the owner (or the merge batch's trial build) should confirm by compile before it goes green. Labels set: needs-rework and conflicts removed (both are false now), needs-maintainer added.

Maintainer decision, 2026-11-22: merge after the trial-merge gate.

The coordinator runs the `camcraft-ui` lib tests and clippy on a local trial merge with current `main` (named binaries, no app window). It merges pinned to the head if the run is green. The label `needs-maintainer` is removed.

Coordinator: the maintainer decided to merge this PR after a test run of the trial merge with the current `main`. That run (main 6679b1b4b + head fe605f8ec, the merge has no conflict) is red, so I set `needs-rework`.

## What is red
`cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib`: 1430 passed, 4 failed. Each of the 4 tests stops with "Found two or more nodes matching the query":

- `egui_app::tests::browser_show_and_hide_all_toolpaths_update_operation_eyes` (`tests.rs:560`), label "Show all toolpaths"
- `egui_app::tests::click_toggles_view_state` (`tests.rs:512`), label "Show all toolpaths"
- `egui_app::tests::display_menu::the_display_button_opens_and_closes_the_menu_and_the_labels_exist` (`display_menu.rs:36`), label "Display mode"
- `egui_app::tests::page_layout_windows::layout_window_display_menu` (`page_layout_windows.rs:13`), label "Display mode"

The same 4 tests pass on `main` without this PR. A probable cause, not confirmed: the new tooltips give a viewport button a second AccessKit node with the same label as an existing control, so a query for one node finds two.

## What is green
- The tests of this PR passed (`nav_buttons_attach_tooltips_on_hover`, `nav_buttons_have_distinct_labels_and_descriptive_tooltips`, and the 9 `viewport_bar::tests`).
- Clippy for `camcraft-ui` is clean.
- The diff reaches no heavy lane.

## Next step
This PR had no change for more than 24 hours, so we do the fix on this branch: we merge `main` into it and make the labels of the new tooltips different from the labels of the existing controls (or scope the 4 queries, if the product is right). We comment here what we pushed. You do not have to do anything, but your comments are welcome.

Hello @JSwetz, thank you for the tooltips. We pushed a refresh to your branch, by the maintainer edit permission. We did not rebase and we did not force-push.

**What we pushed**

- `a4f8cf374`: a merge of `main` into the branch. Git merged with no conflict and we made no hand edits.
- `3e875d1a3`: a change to the accessible names of three viewport bar buttons, in `viewport_bar_text.rs` and `viewport_bar_tooltip_tests.rs`.

**Why**

After the merge of `main`, four existing UI tests failed with `Found two or more nodes matching the query`:

- `egui_app::tests::browser_show_and_hide_all_toolpaths_update_operation_eyes`
- `egui_app::tests::click_toggles_view_state`
- `egui_app::tests::display_menu::the_display_button_opens_and_closes_the_menu_and_the_labels_exist`
- `egui_app::tests::page_layout_windows::layout_window_display_menu`

**Cause**

This PR gives each bar button an accessible name with `widget_info`. Two of these names were already the names of other controls:

- The toolpaths button had the name "Show all toolpaths". The View menu check box has the same name.
- The wireframe button had the name "Display mode". The Display menu group has the same name.

Thus a search by name found two nodes. A script or a screen reader also cannot tell these controls apart. A name must identify one control. The tooltip is the description.

**The change**

- The wireframe button is now "Switch wireframe".
- The toolpaths button is now "Show or hide toolpaths".
- The projection button is now "Switch projection". The View menu also has a "Projection" row, so we changed this name too.
- The other names stay as you wrote them. The tooltips do not change.
- `nav_buttons_have_distinct_labels_and_descriptive_tooltips` now checks that no two buttons have the same name. It also checks that no button takes one of the names above.

The four old tests pass with no change to them.

**Results on the new head `3e875d1a3`** (debug, Windows)

- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib`: `test result: ok. 1434 passed; 0 failed; 8 ignored`.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

`cargo xtask merge-plan --delta 2921 --reviewed fe605f8ec` gives `NEW CODE` (the merge of main has no hand edits; the name commit is new). A reviewer reads the new commit before the merge. We did not change the labels or the draft state.

Hello @JSwetz, thank you for the tooltips. This is a review of the two new commits on top of the review at `fe605f8ec` (comment 7052183244). It is a read only. This review did not build the PR.

**Verdict: clean.** I found no blocker.

**What I checked**

- The head is `3e875d1a3`. Since `fe605f8ec`, the first-parent line has only `a4f8cf374` and `3e875d1a3`.
- `a4f8cf374` is a merge of `main`. Its `git show --remerge-diff` is empty: there are no hand edits.
- `3e875d1a3` changes only `viewport_bar_text.rs` and `viewport_bar_tooltip_tests.rs`. In `label()`, three names change:
  - Wire: "Display mode" becomes "Switch wireframe".
  - Paths: "Show all toolpaths" becomes "Show or hide toolpaths".
  - Projection: "Projection" becomes "Switch projection".
- The new names are plain English and tell what the button does. Each name is unique among the 13 bar buttons. No other control in `crates/ui/src` uses one of these names.
- `label()` is the accessible name (`viewport_bar.rs:246`, `WidgetInfo::labeled`). The `tooltip()` texts did not change.
- The label test `nav_buttons_have_distinct_labels_and_descriptive_tooltips` keeps all its earlier asserts. It now also asserts that no name repeats, and that no name equals "Show all toolpaths", "Projection", "Wireframe" or `display_menu::GROUP_MODE`. Nothing is weaker.
- The 4 tests that were red (in `tests.rs`, `display_menu.rs` and `page_layout_windows.rs`) are not edited. The fix is in the PR's own code.
- The whole PR against `main` is 4 files in `crates/ui`. No snapshot PNG changes. The PR adds 3 `#[test]` and removes none. All files are below 400 lines (the largest is `viewport_bar_tooltip_tests.rs`, 328 lines).
- The body has a `Changelog:` line and `Fixes #2914`. It has screenshots of each tooltip, on hover. The tooltip text did not change, so the screenshots stay correct.

**Note (not a blocker):** the list of names in the PR body ("What changed") still shows the old names "Display mode", "Show all toolpaths" and "Projection". You can update it, if you want.

**Tests**

These were run by the refresh agent on this head, which contains `main`:

- `camcraft-ui` lib, all tests: 1434 passed, 0 failed, 8 ignored.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

Heavy lanes: the diff reaches none (it changes `crates/ui` only).

Coordinator: this PR merges now, by the maintainer's decision of 2026-11-22 (merge after a green test run of the merged tree).

- Class: NEW CODE after the review of fe605f8ec: a merge of `main` with no hand edits, and one fix commit that we pushed (comment 7080470534).
- Review: comment 7080510160 on this exact head 3e875d1a3 (clean).
- Gate: the head contains the current `main` (6679b1b4b). On this head the `camcraft-ui` lib passed (1434 passed, 0 failed, 8 ignored) and clippy is clean.
- Heavy lanes: the diff reaches none (`camcraft-ui` files only).
- Screenshots of the tooltips are in the body. One text in the body is old: the list "What changed" still has the names "Display mode", "Show all toolpaths" and "Projection" for three bar buttons. Their names are now "Switch wireframe", "Show or hide toolpaths" and "Switch projection".

Thank you for the contribution.
